items.source: request - current HTTP request
items.translation: request - 当前 HTTP 请求

items.source: Instantiate the WebApplicationContext for this servlet, either a default XmlWebApplicationContext or a custom context class, if set.
items.translation: 为此 Servlet 实例化 WebApplicationContext，默认为XmlWebApplicationContext，如果设置了则使用自定义上下文类。

items.source: Specify which ApplicationContextInitializer instances should be used to initialize the application context used by this FrameworkServlet.
items.translation: 指定应使用哪些ApplicationContextInitializer实例来初始化此FrameworkServlet使用的应用程序上下文。

items.source: Delegate DELETE requests to processRequest(HttpServletRequest, HttpServletResponse).
items.translation: 将 DELETE 请求委托给processRequest(HttpServletRequest, HttpServletResponse)。

items.source: Delegate POST requests to processRequest(HttpServletRequest, HttpServletResponse).
items.translation: 将 POST 请求委托给processRequest(HttpServletRequest, HttpServletResponse)。

items.source: Delegate PUT requests to processRequest(HttpServletRequest, HttpServletResponse).
items.translation: 将 PUT 请求委托给processRequest(HttpServletRequest, HttpServletResponse)。

items.source: Return the name of the ServletContext attribute which should be used to retrieve the WebApplicationContext that this servlet is supposed to use.
items.translation: 返回应使用以检索此 Servlet 打算使用的 WebApplicationContext 的 ServletContext 属性名称。

items.source: Set the name of the ServletContext attribute which should be used to retrieve the WebApplicationContext that this servlet is supposed to use.
items.translation: 设置用于检索此 Servlet 应该使用的 WebApplicationContext 的 ServletContext 属性名称。

items.source: Specify the set of fully-qualified ApplicationContextInitializer class names, per the optional "contextInitializerClasses" servlet init-param.
items.translation: 指定可选的 "contextInitializerClasses" Servlet 初始化参数中定义的完全限定 ApplicationContextInitializer 类名集合。

items.source: wac - the configured WebApplicationContext (not refreshed yet)
items.translation: wac - 已配置的 WebApplicationContext（尚未刷新）

items.source: the WebApplicationContext for this servlet
items.translation: 此 servlet 的 WebApplicationContext

items.source: Subclasses must implement doService(HttpServletRequest, HttpServletResponse) to handle requests. Because this extends HttpServletBean rather than HttpServlet directly, bean properties are automatically mapped onto it. Subclasses can override initFrameworkServlet() for custom initialization.
items.translation: 子类必须实现doService(HttpServletRequest, HttpServletResponse)以处理请求。由于该类扩展的是HttpServletBean而非 HttpServlet 本身，因此 bean 属性会自动映射到其上。子类可以重写initFrameworkServlet()以进行自定义初始化。

items.source: Detects a "contextClass" parameter at the servlet init-param level, falling back to the default context class, XmlWebApplicationContext, if not found. Note that, with the default FrameworkServlet, a custom context class needs to implement the ConfigurableWebApplicationContext SPI.
items.translation: 检测 servlet init-param 级别的"contextClass"参数，如果未找到则回退到默认上下文类 XmlWebApplicationContext。请注意，使用默认的 FrameworkServlet时，自定义上下文类需要实现 ConfigurableWebApplicationContext SPI。

items.source: Accepts an optional "contextInitializerClasses" servlet init-param that specifies one or more ApplicationContextInitializer classes. The managed web application context will be delegated to these initializers, allowing for additional programmatic configuration, for example, adding property sources or activating profiles against the context's environment. See also ContextLoader which supports a "contextInitializerClasses" context-param with identical semantics for the "root" web application context.
items.translation: 接受一个可选的 `contextInitializerClasses` servlet init-param，用于指定一个或多个 `ApplicationContextInitializer` 类。托管的 Web 应用程序上下文将委托给这些初始化器，从而允许进行额外的程序化配置，例如针对 上下文的 environment 添加属性源或激活配置文件。另请参阅支持具有相同语义的 `contextInitializerClasses` context-param 的 `ContextLoader`，该参数用于“根”Web 应用程序上下文。

items.source: Calling setContextClass(Class) (init-param 'contextClass') overrides the default XmlWebApplicationContext and allows for specifying an alternative class, such as AnnotationConfigWebApplicationContext.
items.translation: 调用 `setContextClass(Class)`（init-param 'contextClass'）会覆盖默认的 `XmlWebApplicationContext`，并允许指定一个替代类，例如 `AnnotationConfigWebApplicationContext`。

items.source: Calling setContextInitializerClasses(String) (init-param 'contextInitializerClasses') indicates which ApplicationContextInitializer classes should be used to further configure the internal application context prior to refresh().
items.translation: 调用setContextInitializerClasses(String)（init-param 'contextInitializerClasses'）指示应使用哪些ApplicationContextInitializer类，以便在 refresh() 之前进一步配置内部应用程序上下文。

items.source: The given web application context may or may not yet be refreshed. If it (a) is an implementation of ConfigurableWebApplicationContext and (b) has not already been refreshed (the recommended approach), then the following will occur:
items.translation: 给定的 Web 应用程序上下文可能尚未刷新。如果它 (a) 是ConfigurableWebApplicationContext的实现，并且 (b) 尚未被刷新（推荐的方法），则会发生以下情况：

items.source: Do not forget to register this servlet instance as application listener on the created context (for triggering its callback), and to call ConfigurableApplicationContext.refresh() before returning the context instance.
items.translation: 不要忘记在创建的上下文中将此 Servlet 实例注册为应用程序监听器（以触发其 callback），并在返回上下文实例之前调用ConfigurableApplicationContext.refresh()。

items.source: Note that this method is designed to allow subclasses to modify the application context, while initWebApplicationContext() is designed to allow end-users to modify the context through the use of ApplicationContextInitializers.
items.translation: 请注意，此方法旨在允许子类修改应用程序上下文，而 initWebApplicationContext() 旨在允许最终用户通过使用ApplicationContextInitializers来修改上下文。

items.source: FrameworkServlet may be injected with a web application context, rather than creating its own internally. This is useful in Servlet 3.0+ environments, which support programmatic registration of servlet instances. See FrameworkServlet(WebApplicationContext) Javadoc for details.
items.translation: FrameworkServlet 可以注入 Web 应用程序上下文，而不是在内部自行创建。这在支持程序化注册 Servlet 实例的 Servlet 3.0+ 环境中非常有用。有关详细信息，请参阅 FrameworkServlet(WebApplicationContext) Javadoc。

items.source: Calling setContextConfigLocation(String) (init-param 'contextConfigLocation') will dictate which XML files will be loaded by the default XmlWebApplicationContext
items.translation: 调用 setContextConfigLocation(String)（init-param 'contextConfigLocation'）将决定由 默认 XmlWebApplicationContext 加载哪些 XML 文件。

items.source: Default in the FrameworkServlet is "false", applying HttpServlet's default behavior (i.e.enumerating all standard HTTP request methods as a response to the OPTIONS request). Note however that as of 4.3 the DispatcherServlet sets this property to "true" by default due to its built-in support for OPTIONS.
items.translation: `FrameworkServlet` 中的默认值为 "false"，应用了 `HttpServlet` 的默认行为（即作为对 OPTIONS 请求的响应枚举所有标准 HTTP 请求方法）。但请注意，从 4.3 版本开始，由于内置了对 OPTIONS 的支持，`DispatcherServlet` 将此属性默认为 "true"。

items.source: When using the default FrameworkServlet implementation, the context class must also implement the ConfigurableWebApplicationContext interface.
items.translation: 使用默认的 FrameworkServlet 实现时，上下文类还必须实现 ConfigurableWebApplicationContext 接口。

items.source: Delegates to createWebApplicationContext(ApplicationContext) for actual creation of the context. Can be overridden in subclasses.
items.translation: 委托给createWebApplicationContext(ApplicationContext) 进行上下文的实际创建。可在子类中重写此方法。

items.source: This implementation expects custom contexts to implement the ConfigurableWebApplicationContext interface. Can be overridden in subclasses.
items.translation: 此实现期望自定义上下文实现 ConfigurableWebApplicationContext 接口。可在子类中重写。

items.source: See also postProcessWebApplicationContext(ConfigurableWebApplicationContext), which is designed to allow subclasses (as opposed to end-users) to modify the application context, and is called immediately before this method.
items.translation: 另请参阅 postProcessWebApplicationContext(ConfigurableWebApplicationContext)，该方法是专为允许子类（而非最终用户）修改应用程序上下文而设计的，并且会在本方法之前立即被调用。

items.source: The default implementation calls onRefresh(ApplicationContext), triggering a refresh of this servlet's context-dependent state.
items.translation: 默认实现会调用onRefresh(ApplicationContext)，从而触发此 Servlet 的上下文相关状态的刷新。

items.source: Will also be invoked by HttpServlet's default implementation of doHead, with a NoBodyResponse that just captures the content length.
items.translation: 也将由 `HttpServlet` 的默认 `doHead` 实现调用，该实现使用一个仅捕获内容长度的 `NoBodyResponse`。

items.source: The actual event handling is performed by the abstract doService(HttpServletRequest, HttpServletResponse) template method.
items.translation: 实际的事件处理由抽象模板方法`doService(HttpServletRequest, HttpServletResponse)`执行。

items.source: The contract is essentially the same as that for the commonly overridden doGet or doPost methods of HttpServlet.
items.translation: 该合约本质上与 `HttpServlet` 中常用的重写 `doGet` 或 `doPost` 方法的合约相同。

items.source: Default is "false", applying HttpServlet's default behavior (i.e. reflecting the message received back to the client).
items.translation: 默认为"false"，应用HttpServlet的默认行为（即把接收到的消息反射回客户端）。

items.source: The default implementation is empty. refresh() will be called automatically after this method returns.
items.translation: 默认实现为空。此方法返回后，将自动调用refresh()。

items.source: The default implementation returns SERVLET_CONTEXT_PREFIX + servlet name.
items.translation: 默认实现返回 SERVLET_CONTEXT_PREFIX + 服务程序名称。

items.source: This class offers the following functionality:
items.translation: 该类提供以下功能：

items.source:
Passes a "contextConfigLocation" servlet init-param to the context instance,
parsing it into potentially multiple file paths which can be separated by any
number of commas and spaces, like "test-servlet.xml, myServlet.xml".
If not explicitly specified, the context implementation is supposed to build a
default location from the namespace of the servlet.
items.translation: 将"contextConfigLocation"servlet init-param 传递给上下文实例，将其解析为可能包含多个文件路径的列表，这些路径可由任意数量的逗号和空格分隔，例如"test-servlet.xml, myServlet.xml"。如果未显式指定，则应由上下文实现根据 servlet 的命名空间构建默认位置。

items.source:
Note: In case of multiple config locations, later bean definitions will
override ones defined in earlier loaded files, at least when using Spring's
default ApplicationContext implementation. This can be leveraged to
deliberately override certain bean definitions via an extra XML file.
items.translation: 注意：在存在多个配置位置的情况下，后加载的 Bean 定义将覆盖先前文件中定义的 Bean 定义（至少在使用 Spring 的默认 ApplicationContext 实现时是这样）。可以利用这一点，通过额外的 XML 文件有意识地覆盖某些 Bean 定义。

items.source:
The default namespace is "'servlet-name'-servlet", for example, "test-servlet" for a
servlet-name "test" (leading to a "/WEB-INF/test-servlet.xml" default location
with XmlWebApplicationContext). The namespace can also be set explicitly via
the "namespace" servlet init-param.
items.translation: 默认命名空间为 "'servlet-name'-servlet"，例如，对于 servlet-name 为 "test" 的情况（在 XmlWebApplicationContext 中导致默认的 "/WEB-INF/test-servlet.xml" 位置）。也可以通过 "namespace" servlet init-param 显式设置命名空间。

items.source:
This is especially handy during testing, although it is debatable whether
it's good practice to let other application objects access the context this way.
items.translation: 这在测试期间尤其方便，尽管是否允许其他应用程序对象以这种方式访问上下文属于可商榷的范畴。

items.source:
Turn this flag on if you prefer OPTIONS requests to go through the
regular dispatching chain, just like other HTTP requests. This usually
means that your controllers will receive those requests; make sure
that those endpoints are actually able to handle an OPTIONS request.
items.translation: 如果希望 OPTIONS 请求像其他 HTTP 请求一样通过常规分发链，请打开此标志。这通常意味着您的控制器将接收这些请求；请确保这些端点确实能够处理 OPTIONS 请求。

items.source:
Note that HttpServlet's default OPTIONS processing will be applied
in any case if your controllers happen to not set the 'Allow' header
(as required for an OPTIONS response).
items.translation: 请注意，如果您的控制器未设置“允许”（Allow）响应头（这是 OPTIONS 响应所必需的），在任何情况下都会应用 HttpServlet 的默认 OPTIONS 处理。

items.source:
Turn this flag on if you prefer TRACE requests to go through the
regular dispatching chain, just like other HTTP requests. This usually
means that your controllers will receive those requests; make sure
that those endpoints are actually able to handle a TRACE request.
items.translation: 如果希望 TRACE 请求像其他 HTTP 请求一样通过常规分发链，请打开此标志。这通常意味着您的控制器将接收这些请求；请确保这些端点确实能够处理 TRACE 请求。

items.source:
Note that HttpServlet's default TRACE processing will be applied
in any case if your controllers happen to not generate a response
of content type 'message/http' (as required for a TRACE response).
items.translation: 请注意，如果您的控制器未生成内容类型为'message/http'（TRACE 响应所必需）的响应，则无论如何都会应用 HttpServlet 默认的 TRACE 处理。

items.source: Primarily added to support use in embedded servlet containers.
items.translation: 主要用于支持在嵌入式 Servlet 容器中使用。

items.source:
Applies HttpServlet's standard OPTIONS processing otherwise,
and also if there is still no 'Allow' header set after dispatching.
items.translation: 否则应用 HttpServlet 的标准 OPTIONS 处理，并且在分发后仍未设置 'Allow' 标头时也是如此。

items.source: Applies HttpServlet's standard TRACE processing otherwise.
items.translation: 否则，应用 HttpServlet 的标准 TRACE 处理。

items.source:
The default implementation takes the name of the UserPrincipal, if any.
Can be overridden in subclasses.
items.translation: 默认实现会获取 UserPrincipal 的名称（如果有）。可以在子类中重写。

items.source:
This class intercepts calls to ensure that exception handling and
event publication takes place.
items.translation: 该类拦截调用，以确保发生异常处理和事件发布。

items.source: Retrieve a WebApplicationContext from the ServletContext attribute with the configured name.
items.translation: 从带有配置名称的ServletContext属性中检索一个WebApplicationContext。

items.source: Instantiate the WebApplicationContext for this servlet, either a default XmlWebApplicationContext or a custom context class, if set. Delegates to #createWebApplicationContext(ApplicationContext).
items.translation: 为此 Servlet 实例化 WebApplicationContext，默认为XmlWebApplicationContext，如果设置了则使用自定义上下文类。委托给#createWebApplicationContext(ApplicationContext)。

items.source: Delegate the WebApplicationContext before it is refreshed to any ApplicationContextInitializer instances specified by the "contextInitializerClasses" servlet init-param.
items.translation: 在刷新之前，将 `WebApplicationContext` 委托给由 "contextInitializerClasses" Servlet 初始化参数指定的任何 `ApplicationContextInitializer` 实例。

items.source: Delegate OPTIONS requests to processRequest(HttpServletRequest, HttpServletResponse), if desired.
items.translation: 如果希望，可以将 OPTIONS 请求委托给processRequest(HttpServletRequest, HttpServletResponse)。

items.source: Delegate TRACE requests to processRequest(HttpServletRequest, HttpServletResponse), if desired.
items.translation: 如果希望，可以将 TRACE 请求委托给processRequest(HttpServletRequest, HttpServletResponse)。

items.source: Overridden method of HttpServletBean, invoked after any bean properties have been set.
items.translation: 被覆盖的 `HttpServletBean` 方法，在设置任何 Bean 属性后调用。

items.source: Called by Spring via ApplicationContextAware to inject the current application context.
items.translation: 由 Spring 通过ApplicationContextAware调用，以注入当前应用程序上下文。

items.source: Set whether this servlet should dispatch an HTTP OPTIONS request to the doService(HttpServletRequest, HttpServletResponse) method.
items.translation: 设置此 servlet 是否应将 HTTP OPTIONS 请求分派到doService(HttpServletRequest, HttpServletResponse)方法。

items.source: Set whether this servlet should dispatch an HTTP TRACE request to the doService(HttpServletRequest, HttpServletResponse) method.
items.translation: 设置此 servlet 是否应将 HTTP TRACE 请求分派到doService(HttpServletRequest, HttpServletResponse)方法。

items.source: Overridden method of HttpServletBean, invoked after any bean properties have been set. Creates this servlet's WebApplicationContext.
items.translation: 覆盖的HttpServletBean方法，在设置任何 Bean 属性后调用。创建此 Servlet 的 WebApplicationContext。

items.source: Default context class for FrameworkServlet.
items.translation: FrameworkServlet 的默认上下文类。

items.source:
Build a LocaleContext for the given request, exposing the request's
primary locale as current locale.
items.translation: 为给定的请求构建一个 LocaleContext，将请求的主要区域设置暴露为当前区域设置。

items.source:
Build ServletRequestAttributes for the given request (potentially also
holding a reference to the response), taking pre-bound attributes
(and their type) into consideration.
items.translation: 为给定的请求（可能还持有对响应的引用）构建 ServletRequestAttributes，同时考虑预绑定的属性（及其类型）。

items.source: Close the WebApplicationContext of this servlet.
items.translation: 关闭此 servlet 的 WebApplicationContext。

items.source: Return the custom context class.
items.translation: 返回自定义上下文类。

items.source: Return the explicit context config location, if any.
items.translation: 返回显式上下文配置位置（如果有）。

items.source: Return the custom WebApplicationContext id, if any.
items.translation: 返回自定义的 WebApplicationContext ID（如果有）。

items.source:
Return the namespace for this servlet, falling back to default scheme if
no custom namespace was set: for example, "test-servlet" for a servlet named "test".
items.translation: 返回此 Servlet 的命名空间，如果未设置自定义命名空间则回退到默认方案：例如，对于名为"test"的 Servlet，返回"test-servlet"。

items.source: Return this servlet's WebApplicationContext.
items.translation: 返回此 Servlet 的 WebApplicationContext。

items.source:
Whether logging of potentially sensitive, request details at DEBUG and
TRACE level is allowed.
items.translation: 是否允许在 DEBUG 和 TRACE 级别记录可能敏感的请求详细信息。

items.source:
Refresh this servlet's application context, as well as the
dependent state of the servlet.
items.translation: 刷新此 Servlet 的应用程序上下文以及该 Servlet 的依赖状态。

items.source:
Override the parent class implementation in order to intercept requests
using PATCH or non-standard HTTP methods (WebDAV).
items.translation: 覆盖父类实现以拦截使用 PATCH 或非标准 HTTP 方法（如 WebDAV）的请求。

items.source:
Specify a custom WebApplicationContext id,
to be used as serialization id for the underlying BeanFactory.
items.translation: 指定一个自定义的 WebApplicationContext 标识符，将其用作底层 BeanFactory 的序列化标识符。

items.source:
Set a custom namespace for this servlet,
to be used for building a default context config location.
items.translation: 为此 Servlet 设置自定义命名空间，用于构建默认上下文配置位置。

items.source:
Suffix for WebApplicationContext namespaces. If a servlet of this class is
given the name "test" in a context, the namespace used by the servlet will
resolve to "test-servlet".
items.translation: WebApplicationContext 命名空间的后缀。如果此类的 Servlet 在上下文中被命名为 "test"，则 Servlet 使用的命名空间将解析为 "test-servlet"。

items.source:
Prefix for the ServletContext attribute for the WebApplicationContext.
The completion is the servlet name.
items.translation:
用于 WebApplicationContext 的 ServletContext 属性的前缀。
补全内容为 Servlet 名称。

items.source:
Set the context config location explicitly, instead of relying on the default
location built from the namespace. This location string can consist of
multiple locations separated by any number of commas and spaces.
items.translation: 显式设置上下文配置位置，而不是依赖从命名空间构建的默认位置。该位置字符串可以包含由任意数量的逗号和空格分隔的多个位置。

items.source:
Set whether this servlet should publish a ServletRequestHandledEvent at the end
of each request. Default is "true"; can be turned off for a slight performance
improvement, provided that no ApplicationListeners rely on such events.
items.translation: 设置此 servlet 是否应在每个请求结束时发布 ServletRequestHandledEvent。默认为"true"；如果没有任何 ApplicationListener 依赖此类事件，可以将其关闭以略微提高性能。
此方法将在设置任何 Bean 属性并加载 WebApplicationContext 之后被调用。默认实现为空；子类可以重写此方法来执行所需的任何初始化操作。

items.translation: 为每个 Servlet 管理一个 `WebApplicationContext` 实例。Servlet 的配置由其命名空间中的 Bean 决定。

items.translation: postProcessWebApplicationContext(ConfigurableWebApplicationContext) 将被调用。

items.translation: 此 servlet 的 WebApplicationContext，如果未找到则为null

items.translation: jakarta.servlet.ServletException - 在初始化异常的情况下

items.translation: event - 传入的 ApplicationContext 事件

items.translation: 对应的 LocaleContext，或者如果没有要绑定的则返回null。

items.translation: 要绑定的 ServletRequestAttributes，或为保留先前绑定的实例（如果之前未绑定任何内容，则不绑定）而指定 `null`。

items.source: the username, or null if none found
items.translation: 用户名，或者如果未找到则为null。

Publishes events on request processing, whether or not a request is
successfully handled.
items.translation: 在请求处理期间发布事件，无论请求是否成功处理。

items.translation: WebApplicationContext 实例

items.source: WARNING: Do not use inheritance for child threads if you are accessing a thread pool which is configured to potentially add new threads on demand (for example, a JDK ThreadPoolExecutor), since this will expose the inherited context to such a pooled thread.
items.translation: 警告： 如果您正在访问一个可能按需添加新线程的线程池（例如 JDK ThreadPoolExecutor），请勿对子线程使用继承，因为这会将继承的上下文暴露给此类池化线程。

items.source: See WebApplicationInitializer for usage examples.
items.translation: 参见WebApplicationInitializer中的使用示例。

items.source: By default set to false so that request details are not shown.
items.translation: 默认设置为false，因此不显示请求详情。

items.source: Subclasses may override this method to provide a different WebApplicationContext retrieval strategy.
items.translation: 子类可以重写此方法以提供不同的 WebApplicationContext 获取策略。

items.source:
Using this constructor indicates that the following properties / init-params
will be ignored:
items.translation: 使用此构造函数将忽略以下属性/初始化参数：

items.source:
Default is "false", to avoid side effects on spawned background threads.
Switch this to "true" to enable inheritance for custom child threads which
are spawned during request processing and only used for this request
(that is, ending after their initial task, without reuse of the thread).
items.translation: 默认为 "false"，以避免对生成的后台线程产生副作用。将此选项切换为 "true" 可为在请求处理期间生成且仅用于该请求的自定义子线程启用继承（即，线程在完成其初始任务后结束，而不会被重用）。

items.source: This implementation is empty.
items.translation: 此实现为空。

items.source: Set whether to expose the LocaleContext and RequestAttributes as inheritable for child threads (using an InheritableThreadLocal).
items.translation: 设置是否将 LocaleContext 和 RequestAttributes 作为可继承项暴露给子线程（使用 InheritableThreadLocal）。

items.source: Create a new FrameworkServlet that will create its own internal web application context based on defaults and values provided through servlet init-params.
items.translation: 创建一个新的FrameworkServlet，该 Servlet 将基于默认值和通过 servlet init-params 提供的值来创建其内部 Web 应用程序上下文。

items.source: Create a new FrameworkServlet with the given web application context.
items.translation: 创建一个新的带有给定 Web 应用上下文的FrameworkServlet。

items.source: Suffix for WebApplicationContext namespaces.
items.translation: WebApplicationContext 命名空间的后缀。

items.source: Prefix for the ServletContext attribute for the WebApplicationContext.
items.translation: 用于 WebApplicationContext 的 ServletContext 属性的前缀。

items.source: Delegate GET requests to processRequest/doService.
items.translation: 将 GET 请求委托给 processRequest/doService。

items.source:
Subclasses must implement this method to do the work of request handling,
receiving a centralized callback for GET, POST, PUT and DELETE.
items.translation: 子类必须实现此方法以执行请求处理工作，接收针对 GET、POST、PUT 和 DELETE 操作的集中式回调。

items.source: Return the ServletContext attribute name for this servlet's WebApplicationContext.
items.translation: 返回此 servlet 的 WebApplicationContext 的 ServletContext 属性名称。

items.source: Determine the username for the given request.
items.translation: 确定给定请求的用户名。

items.source:
This method will be invoked after any bean properties have been set and
the WebApplicationContext has been loaded.
items.translation: 此方法将在设置任何 Bean 属性并加载 WebApplicationContext 之后被调用。

items.source: Initialize and publish the WebApplicationContext for this servlet.
items.translation: 为此 Servlet 初始化并发布 WebApplicationContext。

items.source: Callback that receives refresh events from this servlet's WebApplicationContext.
items.translation: 接收来自此 servlet 的 WebApplicationContext 刷新事件的回调。

items.source: Template method which can be overridden to add servlet-specific refresh work.
items.translation: 可被重写以添加特定于 Servlet 的刷新工作的模板方法。

items.source:
Post-process the given WebApplicationContext before it is refreshed
and activated as context for this servlet.
items.translation: 在此 Servlet 刷新并激活为上下文之前，对给定的 WebApplicationContext 进行后处理。

items.source: Process this request, publishing an event regardless of the outcome.
items.translation: 无论结果如何，发布事件。

items.source: Set a custom context class.
items.translation: 设置自定义上下文类。

items.source:
Set the context config location explicitly, instead of relying on the default
location built from the namespace.
items.translation: 显式设置上下文配置位置，而不是依赖从命名空间构建的默认位置。

items.source: Whether to log request params at DEBUG level, and headers at TRACE level.
items.translation: 是否在 DEBUG 级别记录请求参数，在 TRACE 级别记录标头。

items.source:
Set whether to publish this servlet's context as a ServletContext attribute,
available to all objects in the web container.
items.translation: 设置是否将此 Servlet 的上下文发布为 ServletContext 属性，供 Web 容器中的所有对象访问。

items.source:
Set whether this servlet should publish a ServletRequestHandledEvent at the end
of each request.
items.translation: 设置此 servlet 是否应在每个请求结束时发布 ServletRequestHandledEvent。

items.source: setApplicationContext in interface ApplicationContextAware
items.translation: `setApplicationContext` 接口 `ApplicationContextAware` 中

items.source: ServletContext and ServletConfig objects will be delegated to the application context
items.translation: ServletContext 和 ServletConfig 对象将被委托给应用程序上下文。

items.source: refresh() will be called
items.translation: refresh() 将被调用

items.source: destroy in interface jakarta.servlet.Servlet
items.translation: destroy 在接口 jakarta.servlet.Servlet 中

items.source: service in class jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServlet
items.translation: service 方法在类 jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServlet 中。

items.source: Exception - in case of any kind of processing failure
items.translation: Exception - 在任何类型的处理失败的情况下

items.source: If the given context does not already have a parent, the root application context will be set as the parent.
items.translation: 如果给定的上下文尚未拥有父容器，则根应用上下文将被设置为父容器。

items.source: If the given context has not already been assigned an id, one will be assigned to it
items.translation: 如果给定的上下文尚未分配 `id`，则为其分配一个。

items.source: webApplicationContext - the context to use
items.translation: webApplicationContext - 要使用的上下文

items.source: enable - whether to enable or not
items.translation: enable - 是否启用

items.source: applicationContext - the ApplicationContext object to be used by this object
items.translation: applicationContext - 此对象将使用的 ApplicationContext 对象

items.source: jakarta.servlet.ServletException - if subclass initialization fails
items.translation: jakarta.servlet.ServletException - 如果子类初始化失败

items.source: context - the current WebApplicationContext
items.translation: context - 当前的 WebApplicationContext

items.source: Field Details
items.translation: 字段详情
